purpose: Test whether glacial split/merge of the same original modern insect sampling pairs is stronger for the insect's recorded larval host climatic landscape than for preselected currently climate-matched OTHER REAL PLANT taxa. Not confirmatory; TTF v05 found negative host identity-specific analogue.

source_eligibility.source_selection_rule: Eligibility uses only original v05 0BP-matched alternative plant IDs and native-host model-success statuses; no v08 glacial patch-split outcome examined.

graph.terrain: Original ICE6G_C physically icefree 0.5 degree PMIP4 majority>=5 of9 10 arcminute subcells separately for0 BP and21ka
graph.climate_main: Original source-trained WCVP-native plant 4 predictor 0BP logistic 10th percentile masked analogous-climate suitability
graph.climate_sensitivity: Same original 416 plant logit source restored from saved 0BP only and independently checked against saved 21ka; finite novel-climate extrapolation included
graph.graphs: For each insect and each historical age, OR all recorded actual host plant climate cells or all donor plants in one frozen alternative plant group. 4-neighbor host patch and 4-neighbor physical landmass with longitude dateline closure.
graph.source_modern_insect_geography: Only original current insect sampling location coordinates and pair IDs; not historical insect locality or genetics
graph.anchor_assignment: At each time age, a modern locality anchor must be on source icefree physical terrain, and assigned to nearest source climate-potential plant patch cell center within radius on the SAME physical landmass. No across-ocean/ice plant jump.
graph.same_original_edge_definition: Only compare pairs with BOTH endpoints contactable under all FOUR actual-host0BP, actual-host21ka, alternate-plant0BP and alternate-plant21ka. Store count of those edges and all unavailable categories; do not treat uncontactable as split.
graph.same_edge_paired_hypothesis: difference-in-differences Δhost−Δalternative, where Δ=(proportion_same_patch21ka−proportion_same_patch0BP) on exact common original pairs, NEGATIVE if the recorded host climate patch is lost more than another plant.
graph.baseline_balancing: Always report present 0BP actual host vs other-plant SAME-PATCH fraction on exactly matched edges. The original donors were matched on observed 0BP climate moments, NOT necessarily current native SDM patch connectivity.
graph.per_species_aggregation: Per-insect median over its source valid alternative groups, never treat the up-to-8 controls as independent insects. Insect groups sharing host sets or donors are dependent; 349 hostsets remain the upper dependency denominator.
graph.no_data: If fewer than one fully comparable original pair to a donor group, record no contrast; even 292 model-eligible species may have smaller graph-contact evaluability. Report >=5-pair stability subset separately without rescuing ineligible species.
results: per donor-group exact edge counts, 0BP baseline, Δhost, Δalternate, Δhost−Δalternate
per-insect median and sign of valid donor comparisons

limits: Alternative real plants were not recorded hosts in original source, but unlisted is NOT biologically confirmed nonhost
Modern-climate-matched alternative plant identities were frozen pre-LGM, but different taxonomic ecological niches and native region ranges remain confounded
Modern insect sampling localities projected into 21ka physical geography are counterfactual anchor positions, not actual ancient insect occurrence
Same source plant climate patch under two ages does not prove actual plant occupied routes or allowed larvae to migrate
Original host-specific climate analogue negative in TTF v0.5 remains frozen negative, and no independent genetic response tested
At most 1-3 recorded accepted larval hosts per insect source may not enumerate all hosts; no on-result retune or subgroup cherry-pick
